scope: Two same-run/same-input clip callback comparisons. Only source path, callback phase, actor slot, parent source frame, and child local frame are compared. This is bounded callback/lifecycle evidence, not full-state or full-character parity.

results.fields: Per-target fields are listed below; source P1 callback instrumentation records the P2 frame, so it is not misrepresented as P1's parent frame.

target_comparisons.note: For P1, the source clip marker's sixth value is P2 current frame and is not misrepresented as P1 parent frame. Tick values are normalized using the first paired callback entry. A native proxy exit after target removal is retained as an extra native observation, not called a source marker.
